description.en: Jerusalem with the districts of Gaza, Jaffa and Hebron (Beersheba district added 1899/1900). British consul (1900): bounded on the north by a line from the mouth of the Auja (Yarkon) to the Jordan bridge near Jericho; east by the Jordan and Dead Sea; south and south-west 'less clear-cut'.
description.ar: القدس مع مقاطعات غزة ويافا والخليل (أُضيفت مقاطعة بئر السبع 1899/1900). القنصل البريطاني (1900): يحدها شمالًا خط من مصب العوجا (اليركون) إلى جسر الأردن قرب أريحا؛ وشرقًا الأردن والبحر الميت؛ أما الجنوب والجنوب الغربي فـ'less clear-cut' [أقل وضوحًا].
description.he: ירושלים עם מחוזות עזה, יפו וחברון (מחוז באר שבע נוסף 1899/1900). הקונסול הבריטי (1900): גבולה בצפון קו ממוצא הירקון (אל-עוג׳א) עד גשר הירדן ליד יריחו; במזרח הירדן וים המלח; בדרום ובדרום-מערב “less clear-cut” [פחות ברור].

sources.quote: Thus Jerusalem with the districts of Gaza, Jaffa and Hebron only formed the “sanjak of Kudus.” It stayed so until World War I.
bounded on the north by a line which may be said to run from the coast of the Mediterranean near the mouth of the river Auja [Yarkon] eastward…to the bridge over the Jordan near Jericho
A year later (1899) an irade was issued by the Sultan authorizing the establishment of the district of Beer Sheba into a qadā’

1864 Vilayet Nizamnamesi ile Suriye vilayetine bağlanan Kudüs mutasarrıflığı 1872’de, önce vilayet haline getirildi ve birkaç ay sonra da müstakil mutasarrıflık şeklinde Dahiliye Nezareti’ne bağlandı.
sources.note: 'The mutasarrifate of Jerusalem, attached to the vilayet of Syria by the 1864 Vilayet Law, was first made a vilayet in 1872 and a few months later attached to the Interior Ministry as an independent mutasarrifate.'

sources.quote: Bu son düzenleme ile Kudüs şehri Yafa, Gazze ve Halilürrahman kazalarının bağlı bulunduğu mutasarrıflığın merkezi olmaya devam etti. Bu kazalar arasına 1900’de Birüssebi kazası da katılacaktı.
sources.note: 'With this last arrangement the city of Jerusalem remained the seat of the mutasarrifate to which the kazas of Jaffa, Gaza and Hebron belonged; the kaza of Beersheba would be added to them in 1900.'

sources.quote: IV. Sanjaq of Jerusalem : * El-Quds (Jerusalem), Yafa (Jaffa). Ghazzeh (Gaza). Khalil er-Rahman (Hebron). Bir Seba‘ (Beersheba).
The kaza of Bir Seba‘ was formed from parts of those of Gaza and Hebron before 1901.

notes.en: Abu-Manneh dates the Beersheba qada to an 1899 irade; PalQuest dates the founding of the township of Bir al-Sabi' to 1900. Aydın (2022) dates the independent mutasarrifate to 1872 (briefly a vilayet, then attached directly to the Interior Ministry) and the addition of the Beersheba kaza to 1900; the Admiralty Handbook (1920) says the kaza was formed from parts of Gaza and Hebron before 1901.
notes.ar: يؤرّخ أبو مَنّه قضاء بئر السبع بإرادة سنية صدرت في 1899؛ ويؤرّخ PalQuest تأسيس بلدة بئر السبع بسنة 1900. ويؤرّخ أيدن (2022) المتصرفية المستقلة بسنة 1872 (ولاية لفترة وجيزة، ثم ارتبطت مباشرة بوزارة الداخلية) وإضافة قضاء بئر السبع بسنة 1900؛ ويقول Admiralty Handbook (1920) إن القضاء تشكّل من أجزاء من غزة والخليل قبل 1901.
notes.he: אבו-מנה מתארך את קזא באר שבע לאירדה משנת 1899; PalQuest מתארך את הקמת העיירה בִּיר אל-סבע לשנת 1900. איידין (2022) מתארך את המותסריפות העצמאית ל-1872 (לזמן קצר וילאייט, ואחר כך מחוברת ישירות למשרד הפנים) ואת הוספת קזא באר שבע ל-1900; ה-Admiralty Handbook (1920) אומר שהקזא נוצר מחלקים של עזה וחברון לפני 1901.

description.en: After the 1906 Ottoman-British agreement fixing the line from Rafah to the Gulf of Aqaba, 'the authority of the governor of Jerusalem extended to Aqaba—an area that included the entire Negev down to Aqaba.'
description.ar: بعد الاتفاق العثماني-البريطاني لعام 1906 الذي حدد الخط من رفح إلى خليج العقبة، 'the authority of the governor of Jerusalem extended to Aqaba—an area that included the entire Negev down to Aqaba.' [امتدت سلطة متصرف القدس إلى العقبة، وهي منطقة شملت النقب كله حتى العقبة].
description.he: לאחר ההסכם העות׳מאני-בריטי של 1906 שקבע את הקו מרפיח למפרץ עקבה, “the authority of the governor of Jerusalem extended to Aqaba—an area that included the entire Negev down to Aqaba.” [סמכות מושל ירושלים השתרעה עד עקבה, אזור שכלל את כל הנגב עד עקבה].

sources.quote: Consequently, the authority of the governor of Jerusalem extended to Aqaba—an area that included the entire Negev down to Aqaba.
the Ottomans separated in 1906 the Qada (subdistrict) of Nazareth from the Sanjaq of Acre and appended it to the Sanjaq of Jerusalem.

sources.locator: section 'World War I and after', paragraph 2
sources.quote: Jerusalem was captured by British and Allied forces under the command of General Sir Edmund (later 1st Viscount) Allenby in December 1917. The remaining area was occupied by the British by October 1918.
The Agreement, signed at Rafah on 1 October 1906, reads in Article 1:
During 1906-8 the kaza of Nazareth, for the convenience of pilgrims, was treated as a portion of the sanjaq of Jerusalem
In 1908 steps were taken to make it a sanjaq having two kazas, Bir Seba‘ and Hafir (or El-‘Auja), and including territory to the south that had belonged to the sanjaq of Kerak

sources.locator: Part I, history section on the British occupation, p. 24
sources.quote: General Allenby began his operations in October, 1917, and on the 31st of the month had taken Beersheba. Gaza fell on the 7th November, and on the 16th November Jaffa was occupied without opposition.

sources.locator: Part I, history section on the British occupation, p. 24
sources.quote: at noon of the 9th December a Turkish parlementaire conveyed the surrender of the city to the Commander-in-Chief

notes.en: Nazareth sub-district attached 1906-1908 (not mapped; the Admiralty handbook says it was treated as part of the sanjaq of Jerusalem 'for the convenience of pilgrims'). In 1908 steps were taken to make Beersheba a separate sanjaq that included territory formerly of the sanjaq of Kerak (Admiralty handbook). The British took Beersheba on 31 October 1917, Gaza on 7 November and Jaffa on 16 November, and Jerusalem surrendered on 9 December 1917 (Luke and Keith-Roach 1922).
notes.ar: أُلحق قضاء الناصرة في 1906-1908 (غير مرسوم؛ يقول دليل الأميرالية إنه عومل جزءاً من سنجق القدس «لراحة الحجاج»). وفي 1908 اتُّخذت خطوات لجعل بئر السبع سنجقاً منفصلاً يضم أراضي كانت تابعة سابقاً لسنجق الكرك (دليل الأميرالية). واستولى البريطانيون على بئر السبع في 31 تشرين الأول/أكتوبر 1917، وعلى غزة في 7 تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر، وعلى يافا في 16 تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر، واستسلمت القدس في 9 كانون الأول/ديسمبر 1917 (لوك وكيث-روتش 1922).
notes.he: נפת נצרת סופחה ב־1906–1908 (לא משורטט; המדריך של האדמירליות אומר שנחשבה לחלק מסנג'ק ירושלים "לנוחות עולי הרגל"). ב־1908 ננקטו צעדים להפוך את באר שבע לסנג'ק נפרד שכלל שטחים שהיו קודם בסנג'ק כרכ (המדריך של האדמירליות). הבריטים כבשו את באר שבע ב־31 באוקטובר 1917, את עזה ב־7 בנובמבר ואת יפו ב־16 בנובמבר, וירושלים נכנעה ב־9 בדצמבר 1917 (לוק וקית'־רוץ' 1922).
